title: commit.bet
tagline: commit.bet is a contest platform that turns your commitments into rewards. Stake crypto on personal goals with communit, achieve milestones and earn rewards!
description:
commit.bet is a contest platform that turns your commitments into achievements. Accessible through the Frame on Warpcast, commit.bet allows you to stake crypto on personal goals, whether it’s fitness, productivity, or onchain activities.

How It Works:
1. Stake Your Crypto: Join a contest by staking an entry fee in crypto, creating a personal investment in your goal. The collective stakes form a prize pool, adding extra incentive to stay committed.

2. Track Your Progress: Throughout the challenge, track your progress transparently on the platform. Stay motivated as you move closer to achieving your goals, knowing that success means a share of the prize.

3. Achieve and Earn: At the end of the commitment period, participants who meet their goals share the prize pool. Those who don’t meet their goals forfeit their stake, which is distributed among the achievers. A small fee is taken from the prize pool, except when more than 96% of participants complete the challenge, ensuring fair rewards for all.

With commit.bet, your success is not only incentivized but also secured and transparent, making every goal an opportunity to earn and grow.
We will enable any community, projects, and individuals to create the contest by themselves.
how_its_made:
We’ve made it easier for users to access commit.bet by enabling them to stake directly from the Frame on Warpcast using Frame.js. 
The frame mechanic is built with Next.js, ensuring a seamless user experience, while the smart contract is deployed on Base Sepolia.
